content.title: About
content.content: Scalloped potato made from fresh tubers is a classic dish where thinly sliced potatoes are baked in a creamy sauce of milk, butter, cheese and seasonings until a golden crust forms.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The dish is popular in North American and European cuisines as a side or a main course.
Thin slices allow the potatoes to absorb the sauce quickly and cook evenly.
The cream sauce is often flavored with nutmeg, which enhances the potato flavor.
Baking creates a crisp top while keeping the interior tender.
Traditionally served hot, garnished with fresh herbs.

items.title: Rich in potassium
items.content: Potatoes provide potassium, which supports normal blood pressure and muscle function.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Contains vitamin B6 and niacin, important for metabolism and nervous system health.

items.title: Energy source
items.content: Carbohydrates give a quick source of energy, useful after physical activity.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: Provides fiber that aids healthy digestion.

items.title: Calcium from cream
items.content: The creamy sauce adds calcium, essential for bones and teeth.

items.title: High calorie content
items.content: The cream sauce and cheese make the dish calorie‑dense; portion control is recommended.

items.title: Lactose presence
items.content: People with lactose intolerance may experience discomfort from the dairy ingredients.

items.title: Sodium level
items.content: Added salt and cheese increase sodium, which can be a concern for hypertension.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: Allergy to milk or cheese requires substitution with plant‑based alternatives.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve hot as a side to meat, fish or poultry, or enjoy it as a main dish. Top with fresh herbs, fried onions or additional seasonings to taste.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Leftover scalloped potatoes keep in the refrigerator for up to 3 days in an airtight container. Reheat in the oven to restore the crispy crust.
